database.sidecarBookkeeping: Native startup and read-only SQLite connections advanced the bookkeeping timestamps of the 0-byte WAL and 32KB SHM sidecars. This is not a main-database content mutation, but it is also not zero filesystem touching.

baselineDiagnosis.primaryEntryBottleneck: Repeated full database preparation and duplicated workbench reads serialized by the database-path preparation lock.
baselineDiagnosis.primaryResidenceBottleneck: The full-screen immersive WebGL background continued processing and rendering on every RAF behind the workbench.

implementation.databasePreparation: Startup, initialization, and restore explicitly call prepare_library_database, which owns full migration, integrity, foreign-key, V20 reference checks, schema initialization, expired Agent-run recovery, and fingerprint registration.
implementation.ordinaryReadFailureContract: Ordinary status, query, and facet reads never fall back to full preparation. An unprepared or fingerprint-stale database returns a stable preparation error.
implementation.facetCacheIdentity: normalized database path + project ID + library revision
implementation.facetReadTransaction: The library revision and all three facet groups are read in one read-only transaction before the revision-scoped cache entry is published.
implementation.facetInvalidation: Known library mutations invalidate entries for the affected database; pagination and refresh do not recompute facets.
implementation.bootstrapReuse: The parent-owned status, facets, and first page are handed to SearchWorkspace as a revision-bound bootstrap snapshot.
implementation.strictModeCoalescing: Same-key setup, page, and detail promises are shared while in flight; stale-response sequence gates remain in place.
implementation.detailOwnership: No first paper is selected automatically. PaperDocumentPanel mounts only after explicit selection, then loads the document snapshot and completed-download list.
implementation.renderBudgetContract: Skipped RAF callbacks do not process or render. The next processed frame advances simulation using wall-clock delta since the previous processed frame; visibility resume resets the timing anchor and budget changes do not rebuild the renderer.
